# Showcase animation runtime

GSAP browser distributions (gsap, Flip, Observer and ScrollTrigger) are copied unmodified from the installed gsap 3.15.0 package with their notices retained. The current gallery uses gsap and Flip; the other files remain for existing reference implementations.

three.module.js is the unmodified, self-contained Three.js r160 browser module from the installed package. Its MIT license is preserved in THREE-LICENSE.txt.

No new package or animation CDN dependency was introduced. Refresh these distributions from installed packages when upgrading, then verify all three gallery modes, resizing, live previews and reduced-motion fallback.
